name: Fly (Volar) [PC]
description: Permite volar. PRESIONA LA TECLA 'F' PARA ACTIVAR/DESACTIVAR. Usa W/A/S/D para moverte y Espacio/Ctrl para subir/bajar.
code:
-- RCC | Fly (PC)
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local flying = false
local speed = 50

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        flying = not flying
        local char = player.Character
        if flying and char then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
            bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
            bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
        elseif char then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local bodyVelocity = hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
            if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if flying then
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local bodyVelocity = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
            if bodyVelocity then
                local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
                bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * speed
            end
        end
    end
end)
print("Fly cargado. Presiona F para activar/desactivar.")

name: Noclip (Atravesar paredes)
description: Te permite atravesar objetos. PRESIONA LA TECLA 'N' PARA ACTIVAR/DESACTIVAR.
code:
-- RCC | Noclip (PC)
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local noclip = false

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
        noclip = not noclip
        if player.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = not noclip
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
print("Noclip cargado. Presiona N para activar/desactivar.")

    local vehicle = CreateVehicle(vehicleName, playerPos.x, playerPos.y, playerPos.z, GetEntityHeading(playerPed), true, false)

end, false)

name: GameGuardian Multi-Choice Template
description: Plantilla de menú de opciones para GameGuardian. Ideal para organizar tus búsquedas de memoria.
code:
-- RCC | GameGuardian Multi-Choice
function choice()
    local t = gg.multichoice({
        'Opción 1: Buscar Vida',
        'Opción 2: Buscar Monedas',
        'Opción 3: Buscar Munición',
        'Salir'
    }, nil, 'RCC Scripts')
    if t == nil then gg.sleep(1) else
        if t[1] then searchHealth() end
        if t[2] then searchCoins() end
        if t[3] then searchAmmo() end
        if t[4] then return end
    end
end

function searchHealth()
    gg.searchNumber('100', gg.TYPE_DWORD)
    gg.alert('Buscando vida...')
end

function searchCoins()
    gg.searchNumber('9999', gg.TYPE_DWORD)
    gg.alert('Buscando monedas...')
end

function searchAmmo()
    gg.searchNumber('30', gg.TYPE_DWORD)
    gg.alert('Buscando munición...')
end

while true do
    if gg.isVisible() then
        gg.setVisible(false)
        choice()
    end
    gg.sleep(100)
end

local function comprimir(s)
  local salida,i={},1
  while i<=#s do
    local c,j=s:sub(i,i),i+1
    while j<=#s and s:sub(j,j)==c do j=j+1 end
    salida[#salida+1]=c..(j-i);i=j
  end
  return table.concat(salida)
end

name: Búsqueda binaria
description: Busca un valor en una lista ordenada y devuelve su posición. Ejemplo independiente de Lua; ejecuta el bloque completo.
code:
-- RCC | Búsqueda binaria
local function buscar(lista, objetivo)
  local izquierda, derecha = 1, #lista
  while izquierda <= derecha do
    local medio = math.floor((izquierda + derecha) / 2)
    if lista[medio] == objetivo then return medio end
    if lista[medio] < objetivo then izquierda = medio + 1 else derecha = medio - 1 end
  end
  return nil
end
assert(buscar({2, 5, 9, 14, 20}, 14) == 4)
assert(buscar({2, 5, 9}, 8) == nil)
print("Búsqueda completada")

name: Cola FIFO
description: Procesa tareas en el orden en que llegaron sin desplazar toda la tabla. Ejemplo independiente de Lua; ejecuta el bloque completo.
code:
-- RCC | Cola FIFO
local cola, primero, ultimo = {}, 1, 0
local function agregar(valor)
  assert(valor ~= nil)
  ultimo = ultimo + 1
  cola[ultimo] = valor
end
local function sacar()
  if primero > ultimo then return nil end
  local valor = cola[primero]
  cola[primero] = nil
  primero = primero + 1
  if primero > ultimo then primero, ultimo = 1, 0 end
  return valor
end
agregar("Inicio"); agregar("Meta")
assert(sacar() == "Inicio")
assert(sacar() == "Meta")
assert(sacar() == nil)
print("Cola completada")

local function agrupar(texto)
  local grupos = {}
  for i = 1, #texto do
    local c = texto:sub(i, i)
    local ultimo = grupos[#grupos]
    if ultimo and ultimo.caracter == c then ultimo.cantidad = ultimo.cantidad + 1
    else grupos[#grupos + 1] = {caracter=c, cantidad=1} end
  end
  return grupos
end

assert(#grupos == 3 and grupos[1].cantidad == 3)
assert(#agrupar("") == 0)

name: Media móvil
description: Calcula el promedio de las últimas muestras con una ventana limitada. Ejemplo independiente de Lua; ejecuta el bloque completo.
code:
-- RCC | Media móvil
local function mediaMovil(capacidad)
  assert(capacidad > 0 and capacidad == math.floor(capacidad))
  local datos, posicion, cantidad, suma = {}, 1, 0, 0
  return function(valor)
    suma = suma - (datos[posicion] or 0) + valor
    datos[posicion] = valor
    posicion = posicion % capacidad + 1
    cantidad = math.min(capacidad, cantidad + 1)
    return suma / cantidad
  end
end
local media = mediaMovil(3)
assert(media(3) == 3)
assert(media(6) == 4.5)
assert(media(9) == 6)
assert(media(12) == 9)
print("Media móvil verificada")

description: Comprueba el anidado de paréntesis, corchetes y llaves con una pila. Ejemplo independiente de Lua; ejecuta el bloque completo.
code:
-- RCC | Validar paréntesis
local function validar(texto)
  local pila, pares = {}, {[")"]="(", ["]"]="[", ["}"]="{"}
  for i = 1, #texto do
    local c = texto:sub(i, i)
    if c == "(" or c == "[" or c == "{" then pila[#pila + 1] = c
    elseif pares[c] then
      if pila[#pila] ~= pares[c] then return false end
      pila[#pila] = nil
    end
  end
  return #pila == 0
end
assert(validar("{[()]}") and not validar("([)]"))
assert(not validar("(("))
print("Validación completada")

description: Combina dos listas ascendentes sin ordenar de nuevo todos sus elementos. Ejemplo independiente de Lua; ejecuta el bloque completo.

-- RCC | Fusionar listas ordenadas
local function fusionar(a, b)
  local salida, i, j = {}, 1, 1
  while i <= #a and j <= #b do
    if a[i] <= b[j] then salida[#salida+1] = a[i]; i = i + 1
    else salida[#salida+1] = b[j]; j = j + 1 end
  end
  while i <= #a do salida[#salida+1] = a[i]; i = i + 1 end
  while j <= #b do salida[#salida+1] = b[j]; j = j + 1 end
  return salida
end
local lista = fusionar({1, 4, 8}, {2, 4, 9})
assert(table.concat(lista, ",") == "1,2,4,4,8,9")
assert(#fusionar({}, {}) == 0)
print(table.concat(lista, ", "))

local function pagina(numero, tamano)
  assert(numero >= 1 and tamano >= 1)
  local salida = {}

end

local function pagina(numero, tamano)
  assert(numero >= 1 and tamano >= 1)
  local salida = {}
  for i=(numero-1)*tamano+1, math.min(numero*tamano, #resultados) do

local bolsa = { ["Notas"]=60, Fragmentos=6 }
local receta = { ["Notas"]=30, Fragmentos=3 }
local function fabricar()
  for material, cantidad in pairs(receta) do
    if (bolsa[material] or 0) < cantidad then return false end

  for material, cantidad in pairs(receta) do bolsa[material] = bolsa[material] - cantidad end
  bolsa.Herramientas = (bolsa.Herramientas or 0) + 1
  return true
end

-- Perfil configurable: Notas, cantidad 30, ronda 105s.
local resultados = {}
for i=1, 50 do resultados[i] = "Notas " .. i end
local function pagina(numero, tamano)
  assert(numero >= 1 and tamano >= 1)
  local salida = {}
  for i=(numero-1)*tamano+1, math.min(numero*tamano, #resultados) do
    salida[#salida+1] = resultados[i]

  return salida, math.ceil(#resultados/tamano)
end

name: Efectos: explosión visual sin daño
description: Explosión visual al interactuar con un botón; sin presión física ni destrucción de uniones. Ejemplo original para Roblox Studio; no modifica juegos ajenos.

-- RCC | Efectos: explosión visual sin daño
-- Script en ServerScriptService de tu propia experiencia.
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "RCCVisualExplosion"
part.Anchored = true
part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
part.Parent = workspace
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Ver efecto"
prompt.Parent = part
local ready = true
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
  if not ready then return end
  ready = false
  local effect = Instance.new("Explosion")
  effect.BlastRadius = 8
  effect.BlastPressure = 0
  effect.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
  effect.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
  effect.Parent = workspace
  task.delay(2, function() ready = true end)
end)

name: Controles: correr con teclado, mando y botón táctil
description: Alterna la carrera con Shift, L3 o un botón táctil. Conserva la velocidad inicial y se restablece al reaparecer. Ejemplo original para Roblox Studio; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Controles: correr con teclado, mando y botón táctil
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propia experiencia.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local running = false
local humanoid
local normalSpeed = 16
local function bindCharacter(character)
  humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
  normalSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
  running = false
end
local added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
if player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character) end
CAS:BindAction("RCCSprint", function(_, state)
  if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
  if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
    running = not running
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = running and normalSpeed * 1.5 or normalSpeed
  end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3)
CAS:SetTitle("RCCSprint", "Correr")
CAS:SetPosition("RCCSprint", UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.65))
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
  added:Disconnect()
  CAS:UnbindAction("RCCSprint")
  if humanoid then humanoid.WalkSpeed = normalSpeed end
end)

name: Interfaz: barra de salud adaptable
description: HUD que se adapta al ancho de pantalla y vuelve a conectar la salud al reaparecer. Ejemplo original para Roblox Studio; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Interfaz: barra de salud adaptable
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propia experiencia.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCHealth"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 24)
frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.05)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 49)
frame.ClipsDescendants = true
frame.Parent = gui
local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 205, 173)
fill.Parent = frame
local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 250)
text.Parent = frame
local healthConnection, maxConnection
local function bind(character)
  if healthConnection then healthConnection:Disconnect() end
  if maxConnection then maxConnection:Disconnect() end
  local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
  local function update()
    local ratio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(1, humanoid.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
    text.Text = string.format("Salud: %d / %d", humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth)
  end
  healthConnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(update)
  maxConnection = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(update)
  update()
end
local added = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bind)
if player.Character then bind(player.Character) end
script.Destroying:Connect(function()
  added:Disconnect()
  if healthConnection then healthConnection:Disconnect() end
  if maxConnection then maxConnection:Disconnect() end
  gui:Destroy()
end)

name: Panel glass azul · compacto · suave · radio 0
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución compacto de 280 × 160, paleta azul RGB(24, 56, 90), transición Sine de 0.25s y esquinas de 0px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass azul · compacto · suave · radio 0
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 160)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 56, 90)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 280, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 160) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / azul / suave"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / oceano / cuadratico"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

button.Parent = panel

  active = not active

  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})

  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")

button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"

button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel

  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

-- RCC | Panel glass hielo · vertical · rebote · radio 20

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 340)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 98, 116)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 260, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 340) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / hielo / rebote"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")

if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / azul / retroceso"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

-- RCC | Panel glass grafito · cuadrado · cubico · radio 16

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 42)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 320, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 320) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / grafito / cubico"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: FiveM: Positivos → Sumar diez → Producto
description: Receta configurable de datos: positivos, sumar diez y producto. Procesa una tabla local y muestra el resultado. Comparte operaciones con otras variantes. No lee ni modifica memoria de juegos. Los resúmenes vacíos devuelven cero; el producto vacío devuelve uno.
code:
-- RCC | FiveM: Positivos → Sumar diez → Producto
-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.
-- Guarda como client.lua en tu recurso autorizado.
-- fxmanifest.lua separado: fx_version 'cerulean'; game 'gta5'; client_script 'client.lua'
local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1e9,"Usa numeros finitos entre -1e9 y 1e9")
    if x > 0 then values[#values+1]=x+10 end
  end
  local r=1.0; for _,v in ipairs(values) do r=r*v end; return r
end
local input={-12,-5,0,7,12,18,24,31}
local result=calculate(input)
local message="Resultado: "..tostring(result)
print(message)

-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.
-- Guarda como client.lua en tu recurso autorizado.
-- fxmanifest.lua separado: fx_version 'cerulean'; game 'gta5'; client_script 'client.lua'
local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1e9,"Usa numeros finitos entre -1e9 y 1e9")
    if x % 2 == 0 then values[#values+1]=x*x end

local message="Resultado: "..tostring(result)

-- RCC | GameGuardian: Negativos → Limitar entre 0 y 20 → Producto
-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.
-- Guarda como .lua y abre desde GameGuardian.
local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1e9,"Usa numeros finitos entre -1e9 y 1e9")
    if x < 0 then values[#values+1]=math.min(20,math.max(0,x)) end
  end
  local r=1.0; for _,v in ipairs(values) do r=r*v end; return r
end

local message="Resultado: "..tostring(result)

code:
-- RCC | GameGuardian: Mayores de diez → Dividir entre dos → Máximo
-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.
-- Guarda como .lua y abre desde GameGuardian.
local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1e9,"Usa numeros finitos entre -1e9 y 1e9")

  end

end

local message="Resultado: "..tostring(result)

-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.

local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do

end

code:
-- RCC | AutoTouch: Sin ceros → Dividir entre dos → Mínimo
-- Receta combinable: modifica los datos, el filtro o la transformacion.
-- Guarda como .lua y abre desde AutoTouch.
local function calculate(input)
  local values={}
  for _,x in ipairs(input) do
    assert(type(x)=="number" and x==x and math.abs(x)<=1e9,"Usa numeros finitos entre -1e9 y 1e9")
    if x ~= 0 then values[#values+1]=x/2 end
  end
  local r=values[1] or 0; for _,v in ipairs(values) do r=math.min(r,v) end; return r
end

local result=calculate(input)
local message="Resultado: "..tostring(result)
alert(message)
